public_rationale: The opening March tweet omits the domain and success-rate qualifications, supporting Marcus’s narrower concern about presentation. The general description of the blog and tweets as having dropped the qualifications is therefore too broad. The stronger assertion that their claims went far beyond the study is not established merely by the headline omissions.
limitations: This assesses the identified announcements, not every METR tweet.
Historical blog wording is corroborated through a contemporaneous reproduction rather than an immutable archive.
The mixed judgment depends on distinguishing partial omission from wholesale removal.
